policies.sentence: Students may use AI only where the assignment or instructor explicitly permits it.
Individual instructors may disallow AI entirely for assignments.
Instructors may permit AI use or grant exceptions for specific assignments.
Class AI policies are decided by individual faculty.
Instructors must state in assignment instructions when and how AI may be used.
Students may use AI on projects (final, team or capstone), sometimes only for debugging or non-core parts.
Students may use AI for limited listed uses such as learning, open-format homework or study, with citation.
Students must not use AI on exams, quizzes, labs, code review or non-project assignments.
Students must get instructor permission before using AI.
Some assignments may require students to use AI.
Specific assignments where AI is not appropriate will be clearly marked.
Students must follow the course or assignment AI policy when using AI.
Universities acknowledge that there are legitimate uses of AI.
AI rules vary by assignment or deliverable.
